si_4_title: Contrasting Case-Control and Normative Reference Approaches to Capture Clinically Relevant Structural Brain Abnormalities in Patients With First-Episode Psychosis Who Are Antipsychotic Naive

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "We recruited patients with FEP from clinical sites at the University of Alabama at Birmingham..." "We quantified individual deviations ... based on a normative reference model (n = 58 836) ... We used control data to calibrate normative curves."

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: The UAB dataset (SINGLE-SITE) controls were used for calibrating the normative curves, and patients were used for testing/analysis. The Pre-Trained NM (Brain Charts) was used as the reference model.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "We quantified individual deviations ... based on a normative reference model (n = 58 836) ... We used control data to calibrate normative curves." "...quantified raw subcortical and ventricle volumes as well as deviations from a normative reference model at baseline."

dc_3_healthy_control_number_of_each_norm.detail: The study uses a pre-trained normative reference model based on 58,836 individuals (Brain Charts). It also uses 92 local controls for calibration, but the base model N is 58,836.
dc_3_healthy_control_number_of_each_norm.reason: The paper explicitly states the normative reference model has n=58,836. The local controls (n=92) are used for calibration, which is a transfer/adaptation step, not the primary training of the base model.

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_model.detail: Age statistics for the 58,836 subjects in the pre-trained model are not reported in this paper.
dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_model.reason: The paper refers to a pre-trained model (Brain Charts) and does not restate the demographics of the training set. It only reports demographics for the local cohort (n=190 total, 92 controls).
